whatToTest:
Look Twice and Explain it back. Prepared title for the next App Store submission: Tend: A Little Room to Think. The icon and Siri name remain Tend.

1. Open the reasoning desk from Focus. Open “Explore a format · optional” and choose Look twice: an everyday case about what was observed, what was inferred, and what else could explain it. Make a prediction, consider assumptions, keep or revise it, and open hints individually. Explicit reveal also works without choosing an answer.
2. Read the explanation, alternative feedback and source links. Before or after marking the idea explored, try the optional Explain it back prompt in your own words. This is a private note, not an automatically graded test.
3. Close and reopen Tend during a case or after writing a note. Initial and final predictions, optional notes, hints, teach-back and completion should persist.
4. Try the related variation. After completing a daily idea, a related review appears a few local calendar days later without a catch-up requirement. Reasoning has no timer, scores, leaderboard or lost streak.
5. In Settings, export and restore a backup; reasoning notes and progress should be included. Activities and saved progress work offline, with no AI service receiving notes. External source links need internet.
6. Check that focus sessions, the notebook, warm-up/rest, Siri, the Lock Screen timer and optional app blocking still work as before.
whatsNew:
Tend is now A Little Room to Think.

Look Twice brings short, authored everyday reasoning cases: separate observation from interpretation, consider other explanations, and ask what evidence would change your mind.

After an explanation, optionally Explain it back in your own words. Keep the idea and your questions in a private note, and return to a related review a few days later.

Daily physics, gentle introductions, focus sessions and your notebook are still here. Reasoning stays untimed and unscored, with no streak to lose. Notes stay on your device and travel in your Tend backups.
reviewNotes:
New in 1.3: Look Twice, optional Explain it back notes, and the App Store title Tend: A Little Room to Think. The on-device icon name remains Tend.

No login, subscription, network or setup is required. The interface, fonts and authored content are bundled offline.

1. Focus tab: scroll below the timer/intention cards to the reasoning activity and open its desk. Open “Explore a format · optional”, choose Look twice, and select a case. Cases distinguish observations, interpretations, alternative explanations, and evidence that could change a conclusion.
2. Choose a prediction and optionally add a reason. Consider the assumptions, keep or revise the prediction, and optionally record what changed your mind. Hints open individually. Submit to see the explanation, or explicitly reveal without a prediction.
3. Read the stepwise explanation, alternative feedback, conditions and supporting sources. Mark the idea explored. Try the optional variation. Explain it back is available before or after completion; the latter is a private note in the user's own words and receives no AI or automatic grading.
4. Close/reopen the app: predictions, optional notes, hints and completion persist. Related reviews appear a few local calendar days after completing a daily idea. Reasoning has no timer, score, leaderboard, intelligence rating or lost streak.
5. Settings > Export backup / Restore backup includes reasoning progress and notes. No personal notes are sent to an AI or analytics service. All cases are authored; no runtime question generation.

The existing physics reasoning, focus timer, notebook, warm-up/rest, Siri, Live Activity and optional Screen Time app blocking remain. Source links open externally. No data is collected.
